bphs-97:santhanam:ch21:v19-21.exact_text: 19-21. Combinations for Fame. One will be endowed with fame, if Chandra is in Karm Bhava, while Karm’s Lord is in a trine from Karm Bhava and Lagn’s Lord is in Lagn’s angle. Similar effects will come to pass, if Labh’s Lord is in Karm Bhava, while Karm’s Lord is strong and gives a Drishti to Guru. Fame will come to the native, if Karm’s Lord is in Dharm Bhava, as Lagn’s Lord is in Karm Bhava and Chandra is in Putr Bhava.
